meta.title: Fuzzy Line-Item Matching: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and attempt Fuzzy Line-Item Matching between invoice and PO line-item descriptions.
Repeat the action as an AP Executive and compare whether the capability is offered and succeeds.
Ensure or verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and attempt Fuzzy Line-Item Matching between invoice and PO line-item descriptions.; Repeat the action as an AP Executive and compare whether the capability is offered and succeeds.; Ensure or verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan.

args.need: sign in as both the non-AP-Executive user and the AP Executive in the same Growth tenant, attempt Fuzzy Line-Item Matching between invoice and PO line-item descriptions for each user, and report whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate invoice/PO matching or switch between role-specific user sessions, so the tester must perform and compare both permission checks.
Assert that the available Procol session exposes its known sign-in entry point after the tester interaction.
